slices.name: Scoped authorization
slices.implementation: Preserve destination, purpose, original task, accepted chronological steering, and hard read-only limits across resume/restart/compaction. Existing email/Slack drafting rules retain their destinations. Resuming a stopped task records host revocation before the new parent instruction; earlier authorization does not silently carry over.

slices.name: Progress without worker termination
slices.implementation: Meaningful evidence-backed milestones atomically commit with an idempotency receipt and parent wake. Working continues; waiting/blocked ends only the current turn after a successful save.

slices.name: Durable ownership and waiting
slices.implementation: Waiting is visible and stoppable, releases graphical capacity, retains original lineage, records next action/check/deadline, and resumes through the existing worker queue. Initial formal partial/blocked final reports remain pending and parent-owned without an automatic retry.

slices.name: Safe reconciliation
slices.implementation: Current-run checks reject stale reports/completions. Recovery stops old Pi contexts before redrive, fences claims/initial dispatch, preserves ownership, and requires live-state reconciliation before uncertain external effects.

slices.name: Work and latency
slices.implementation: Report verified milestones before optional evidence polish, preserve required verification and follow-ups, and park outside dependencies instead of spending model calls on unchanged polling.
slices.measurement: Provider state and timestamps, delayed-question response, parent relay, browser/model calls, provider-estimated cost. Same-code low/medium reasoning is a separate exploratory ablation, not a changed default.
